questions.question: What is the growth outlook for South Asia in this report?
questions.expected: Growth in SAR is expected to soften to 6.3 percent in 2026 (conflict in the Middle East: energy prices, remittances, tourism)
evidence: Growth in SAR is expected to soften to 6.3

questions.question: What does Chapter 3 say about sovereign debt in developing economies?
questions.expected: Rising government debt raises interest rates: spreads and yields up about 110 and 30 basis points since 2010; non-linear (bigger effect at higher debt)

questions.question: According to the executive summary, what are the main risks to the global outlook?
questions.expected: Risks skewed to the downside: renewed escalation of hostilities / prolonged commodity disruptions raising prices, inflation, food insecurity, financial stress
evidence: Risks to the outlook remain skewed to the downside

questions.question: What growth rate is projected for East Asia and Pacific in 2026?
evidence: Growth in EAP is projected to moderate to 4.2

questions.question: What is the 2026 growth forecast for Sub-Saharan Africa?
questions.expected: Edges down to 4 percent in 2026, recovering to 4.4 percent on average in 2027–28
evidence: Growth in SSA is forecast to edge down to 4 percent

questions.question: How fast is Latin America and the Caribbean expected to grow in 2026?
questions.expected: 2.2 percent in 2026, strengthening to an average of 2.5 percent over 2027–28
evidence: Growth in LAC is projected to slow to 2.2

questions.question: What is the growth projection for Europe and Central Asia in 2026?
questions.expected: 2.1 percent in 2026, picking up to 2.4 percent by 2027–28
evidence: Growth in ECA is projected to decelerate further, to 2.1

questions.question: What is the 2026 growth forecast for the Middle East and North Africa region?
questions.expected: 1.6 percent in 2026 (from 4 percent in 2025), excluding the Islamic Republic of Iran
questions.expectedSection: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan, and Pakistan
evidence: growth in MNA is expected to weaken to 1.6

questions.question: What is the global growth forecast for 2026?
questions.expected: 2.5 percent in 2026, down from 2.9 percent in 2025
evidence: global growth is forecast to decelerate to 2.5 percent in 2026
projected to slow from 2.9 percent in 2025 to 2.5 percent in 2026

questions.question: According to Chapter 3, how does the effect of higher debt on sovereign spreads change as debt rises?
questions.expected: Non-linear: at ~45% of GDP a 1 pp rise adds ~8 bp to spreads; at ~80% it adds ~26 bp
evidence: 8 basis point rise in sovereign spreads

questions.question: In Box 3.1, what happened in Mozambique's tuna bond episode?
questions.expected: Revelation of about 9 percent of GDP in previously undisclosed borrowing (2009–14), with a substantial rise in borrowing costs

questions.question: What does Chapter 4 find about fiscal policy in commodity exporters?
questions.expected: More volatile and more procyclical than in other EMDEs, amplifying business cycles and dampening growth
